description: THE ARM: the write's WHEN OTHER at app/cbl/COUSR01C.cbl:267-273, reached the one way no arrangement of seeded rows can reach it. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY falls through all five blank-field arms to WHEN OTHER at :148-150, which moves the cursor and CONTINUEs, so IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON at :153 is true, the five same-width stores at :154-158 run, and WRITE-USER-SEC-FILE issues the EXEC CICS WRITE at :240-248 with LENGTH OF SEC-USER-DATA = 80 and LENGTH OF SEC-USR-ID = 8, both compile-time constants of app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy. The write is refused with outcome OTHER and no RESP declared at all - the permanent-error shape, a status carrying no CICS response code - which cannot be mistaken for any of the three values :250-274 names, so EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD lands on WHEN OTHER. case10 reaches that arm from a stated RESP of 13; this is the folder's only route to it with nothing reported. The arm does three things and not two: WS-ERR-FLG becomes 'Y', WS-MESSAGE becomes 'Unable to Add User...', and -1 goes to FNAMEL at :272 - not the USERIDL of :265, a two-line difference that is easy to lose. The DISPLAY at :268 is commented out, so nothing is logged. THE MESSAGE, byte by byte: MOVE 'Unable to Add User...' - twenty-one characters - TO WS-MESSAGE PIC X(80) at :270-271 pads the receiver on the right to eighty; SEND-USRADD-SCREEN then performs MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COUSR1AO at :188, and ERRMSGO is PIC X(78) at app/cpy-bms/COUSR01.CPY:90, so COBOL truncates the alphanumeric receiver on the RIGHT and the last two bytes are dropped: 21 -> 80 -> 78. Both channels are stated because they are different fields, and the send carries the narrowed one. WHY THE FIVE TYPED FIELDS ECHO BACK UNBLANKED: this arm does not PERFORM INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS - only :252 does, on the DFHRESP(NORMAL) arm - and COUSR01.CPY:91 declares 01 COUSR1AO REDEFINES COUSR1AI with every xxxO item sitting at its xxxI offset, so what was received is what goes out, at widths 20/20/8/8/1. Contrast case01, where :252 blanks those same five BEFORE :255-258 composes the confirmation. The request is held identical to case01, case08 and case10 on purpose: across the write-outcome family the forced outcome is the single variable. ATTRIBUTES: one item only, ERRMSGC, and here it is DFHDFCOL. MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC at :254 is the only attribute assignment anywhere in COUSR01C, so an error arm keeps the map's own default colour. Both mnemonics come from common.BmsAttributes, which reproduces DFHBMSCA from IBM CICS documentation because that copybook - like DFHAID at :55-56 - is absent from this repository (risk R-D); no value here traces to a copybook in this checkout. COUSR01C:57 carries *COPY DFHATTR., commented out, so no DFHATTR constant is compiled in and none is asserted, and COUSR01C copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY - zero occurrences - so there is no '*' marker and no per-field DFHRED at all. THE DATASET: app/data/ASCII holds nine fixtures and none of them is a usrsec file, so USRSEC is seeded inline from app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44 at the fifty-seven characters the in-stream data carries - id 1-8, first name 9-28, last name 29-48, password 49-56, type 57. The absent span is SEC-USR-FILLER PIC X(23) at CSUSR01Y:23; the 57-to-80 pad is declared once as USRSEC_FILLER_PAD_57_TO_80 and applied at seed time, never at comparison time, which is why every expectation here is stated at the copybook's eighty - the mechanical sum of the six spans 8+20+20+8+1+23 at CSUSR01Y:18-23. SEC-USR-FILLER is a NAMED field and not an anonymous gap: it is space-filled because COUSR01C assigns it nothing, and DUSRSECJ corroborates that independently, STEP01 padding each 57-byte row to eighty through DCB=(LRECL=80,RECFM=FB) at :48 before STEP02 defines the cluster at RECORDSIZE(80,80) and STEP03 REPROs. SEC-USR-PWD stays plaintext exactly as the copybook declares it and COSGN00C compares it; hashing it would change behaviour and would need Spring Security, which is out of scope. THE ROW INDEX, and which reading was used: the model documents two and this case uses both. In expectedWrites the index is the position in that dataset's write sequence - the list is empty, because the write was refused and nothing reached the dataset. In expectedFinalState it is the zero-based row index within the dataset after the run, and USRSEC is key-sequenced: DUSRSECJ.jcl:64-73 defines it KEYS(8,0) RECORDSIZE(80,80) INDEXED and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:88-89 binds FILE(USRSEC) to that cluster with ADD(YES), so 0 through 9 are the key positions ADMIN001 through USER0005. Had the write completed, NEWUSR01 would have landed at zero-based 5: 'N' is x'4E' in US-ASCII, after the 'A' x'41' of ADMIN005 and before the 'U' x'55' of USER0001. No row at that position, and a final state of exactly ten rows, is what proves the refusal was observed as a refusal; case01 is the identical derivation with the row present. DETERMINISM, ENCODING AND STATE: the clock is pinned at 2022-07-19T23:12:34, which is the source's own version stamp at COUSR01C.cbl:298, shared by all twenty cases of this folder and rendered 07/19/22 and 23:12:34 by :223-233, so no wall clock is read; the code page is named explicitly as US-ASCII rather than left to a platform default; the dataset is addressed by its binding key, so no dotted, fully-qualified mainframe dataset name appears here; and sixteen COMMAREA fields travel in and sixteen out, totalling COCOM01Y's 160 bytes, with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT staying 1 because this arm writes no commarea field and nothing is kept on the server. FOLDER ALLOCATION: the DFHRESP(NORMAL) arm - the STRING ... DELIMITED BY SPACE confirmation, DFHGREEN on ERRMSGC, and the full eighty-byte write image pinned across all six CSUSR01Y fields - is owned by case01, with case11, case12 and case20 the other three completed writes; the set carries exactly four, and this case is their permanent-error counterpart and writes nothing. PROVENANCE: every value here is STATICALLY DERIVED and none of it was captured from a running COBOL program, which AAP 0.7.6 proves impossible in this environment with eight independently verified blockers - no z/OS runtime, an available compiler reporting indexed file handler : disabled, no Language Environment CEE services, no CICS emulator, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository. It was read from app/cbl/COUSR01C.cbl:148-160, :238-274 and :287-295 together with :184-196 and :214-233, and cross-checked against app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy:17-23 for the eighty-byte layout, app/cpy-bms/COUSR01.CPY with app/bms/COUSR01.bms for the xxxI and xxxO PICTURE widths - which prove every store at :154-158 is same-width, so nothing is truncated or re-padded on store - app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:18-22 for the two title literals with the CCDA line commented out, app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy for the date and time renderings, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy for the communication area, app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:88-89 for the FILE(USRSEC) ADD(YES) binding, and app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44 and :64-73 for the seed rows and the cluster. Provenance is the only substitution: twenty cases, field-for-field diffing and a required diff count of zero all stand.
